title: Kissed Peppery Syrian Galangal Stew
description: A comforting Syrian stew featuring galangal, this dish is perfect for a chilly evening, with a peppery flavor and a springy texture from the galangal and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat and saute the sliced galangal until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced red bell peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, black pepper, and salt, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sliced hard-boiled eggs and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
